title: Blood Donation Camp
summary: Rotary Club of Mumbai Royales. under *Community Service Medical avenue had organised Blood Donation Drive at two place . one at Teloz Spaces, Marol and 2nd at Surajba Vidya Mandir, Jogeshwari east .
description:
Rotary Club of Mumbai Royales. under *Community Service Medical avenue had organised Blood Donation Drive at two place . one at Teloz Spaces, Marol and 2nd at Surajba Vidya Mandir, Jogeshwari east .
Camp commenced from 9.30 am to 5.30 pm on 24th Oct. 2026.
A total of 49 bottles of blood were collected .
Camp at Surajba Vidya Mandir was supported by Smt. Mamta Pankaj Yadav ( Municipal Councillor Ward 72, BMC)
A heartfelt thank you to Pradeep Ji Bihani and Sanket Bihani for this wonderful initiative and for contributing towards saving precious lives.
Your support and commitment to service are truly appreciated. Every drop counts. Every donor can save a life. ❤️🩸
Let’s show our Rotary spirit through Service Above Self!
location: TELOZ SPACE, Marol Andheri, Mumbai and Surajba Vidya Mandir, Jogeshwari east ., Maharashtra
